text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ouch, ouch, ouch! That hurts like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But I have to hurry and get back to
training!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! At times like this, I can
just tape
up, take some painkillers, and
push through!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As long as I tend to my injury properly,
I'll be able
to keep going!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As long as I tend to my injury properly,
I'll be able
to keep going!
choice_data_list: If you do anything reckless, even a little, I'm stopping you.
If you do anything reckless, even a little, I'll stop you.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But... if I just fix the pain, then I can
keep running!
choice_data_list: If you do anything reckless, even a little, I'm stopping you.
If you do anything reckless, even a little, I'll stop you.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, you're right... If I just end up
making it
worse, that will defeat the
whole purpose...
choice_data_list: Masking the pain doesn't mean it's cured.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Waiting around patiently just isn't in my nature!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Okay! I promise I won't do anything rash!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Let's get started right away, then. Umm,
is the
medical tape in the medicine
cabinet?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Eeek! Owowow!
choice_data_list: Ah, I'll look for it, so—!
Ah, I'll look for it, so—!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess takes a tumble and
aggravates
her injury. Naturally, I tell her
to take time off to
recover.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer, can I ask you to fetch
the tape
from the medicine cabinet?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Time for some Princess Taping! Pain,
pain, go
away!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Now I can get back to strength
training no
problem!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Thank you for believing in me
and letting
me continue my training.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I feel like I can overcome any
obstacle
that stands in my way.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have you by my side, of
course.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And on that note, it's time to plunge
back into
training! Full throttle! But with
caution! Let's get
lifting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Kawakami Princess is able to
overcome
her injury and continue her
training, taking care
not to push herself
too hard.
